Artificial Christmas Tree
This artificial Christmas tree adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. The green and white finish and plastic and metal construction give it a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Pine Cone Detail
Pine cone details add texture among the festive foliage. Their recognisable shapes help create a woodland inspired arrangement, making the decoration easy to coordinate with other natural looking Christmas accessories.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

Product details
Material: Plastic and Metal. Colour: Green and White. Stated size: 180 cm. Product weight: 6.12 kg. Quantity: 1 piece.
Pine cone details add texture and a woodland-inspired aesthetic to your festive display.
Stands at a substantial 180 cm height, creating a striking focal point for Christmas celebrations.
Constructed from durable plastic and metal materials for long-lasting seasonal use.
Features a classic green and white colour scheme that coordinates easily with natural accessories.
Guarantee - 1 month

5014555703021.sourceDescription:
This 2ft snowy tree is designed for the spaces that don't suit a full-sized tree – windowsills, bedside tables, desks, and dining tables. Snow-dusted white-tipped branches sit in a hessian base that gives it a neat, self-contained look without the need for a separate stand or pot. It's ready to place and display. 

30 warm white LEDs are pre-woven throughout for a steady, warm glow. Battery powered and fully wire-free, it can be positioned anywhere in the room without a socket nearby. A built-in digital timer runs an 8 hours on / 16 hours off cycle, so the lights switch themselves on and off each day. 

Light branch shaping required. Unpack, shape the branches by hand for the fullest appearance, switch on the lights, and it's done. 

Ideal for: Windowsills, bedside tables, desks, dining tables, home offices, and any space where a small but fully formed Christmas tree makes the difference.
Guarantee - 1 year
Comes with 1x 2ft pre-lit faux snowy Christmas tree with hessian base
Tree type - Table top
Assembly required

Add a different shape to a Christmas tree with this set of six cone-shaped ornaments. The velvet-effect flocked surface creates a soft, textured appearance, providing a contrast to smooth baubles, metallic decorations and natural-looking foliage.

The suspended format also makes the set suitable for a window display or another seasonal hanging arrangement.

The six-piece set weighs approximately 90 g in total and comes in transparent PVC packaging. The light overall format is convenient to handle while decorating, and the packaging can help keep the pieces together between seasons. Use a suitable display location and avoid crushing the flocked surfaces during storage.

The pack contains six hanging cone ornaments. They can be used on a Christmas tree, incorporated into a table arrangement or displayed with other seasonal accessories. Their combination of a distinctive shape, velvet-style finish and supplied hanging cords makes them a reusable decorative addition for a textured festive scheme.

Set of six cone-shaped ornaments with included hanging cords for easy display on trees or hooks.

5052532166421.sourceDescription:
Christmas Wreath
It adds a festive detail to your Christmas display.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

Product details
Material: Fabric. Quantity: 1 set.
Festive fabric wreath designed to add a practical decorative detail to your Christmas display.
Creates a focal point for your arrangement, allowing its outline and details to remain visible.
Single set quantity allows for easy coordination with existing colour and texture accents.
Flexible design enables simple repositioning within the setting to refresh the overall look.
Comes with 1 x Christmas Wreath

5096042275921.baseName: Christmas door wreath - Artificial pine cone wreath to decorate doors, walls and mantelpieces through the festive season - 30 cm
5096042275921.variantName: Christmas door wreath - Artificial pine cone wreath to decorate doors, walls and mantelpieces through the festive season - 30 cm
5096042275921.sourceDescription:
A small artificial wreath brings pine cone detail to a door, wall or mantel display. The 30 cm size works particularly well where the decoration will be seen at close range, with enough space around it to show its outline. It can be used indoors or outdoors, so the same decoration can move between a hallway and an entrance as your plans change.

A wreath puts the decoration on the door or wall itself, leaving the console or mantelpiece below free for cards and winter flowers. Its outline is complete in one piece, which is handy in an entrance where there is little space for a tree. From a few steps away the cones read as dark accents. Closer up, their overlapping scales contrast with the finer foliage. A simple ribbon or a nearby wooden decoration will pick up that woodland detail.

For a simpler finish, keep additional decorations to one part of the ring and let the natural shape of the foliage show elsewhere. A ribbon tied off-centre can pick up a colour from the tree without covering the sprigs. A green wreath also works as a bridge between rooms. Choose one shade from your tree decorations for the hallway and repeat it in a small accent beside the wreath, letting the greenery carry the rest of the scheme.

On a mantel wall, the wreath can sit above the display while the shelf below stays clear for cards and small ornaments. Leave a little space between the top of the cards and the bottom of the wreath so their outlines remain distinct. A simple way to plan the setting is to mark the centre of the intended space with a small piece of paper. Hold the decoration over it, then step back to see how it sits alongside the door surround or other wall decorations.

For a wall arrangement, try the wreath above a narrow console with the centre of the design just below eye level.
Compact 30cm artificial pine cone wreath ideal for close-range display on doors, walls or mantelpieces.
Versatile indoor and outdoor design allows easy movement between hallway and entrance decorations.
Complete one-piece ring outline provides a neat finish without requiring additional assembly.
Detailed overlapping pine cone scales contrast with fine foliage for a realistic woodland look.

Create a welcoming Christmas atmosphere with this 60cm Light Up Gold Door Wreath. The generously sized circular arrangement combines traditional festive foliage with an elegant selection of gold baubles, glittered leaves, berry sprays and pinecones. A large decorative bow completes the design, bringing the different seasonal elements together for a coordinated appearance. Warm white LEDs are integrated throughout the wreath, creating soft illumination that highlights the ornaments and adds visual interest during evening displays. Choose between two lighting effects, steady or flashing, to personalise the decoration according to your preferred Christmas setting. Battery operation using three AA batteries allows flexible placement without a nearby mains socket, making the wreath convenient for suitable doors, walls, windows and indoor entrance areas. Batteries are not included. Measuring approximately 60cm across, the wreath creates a substantial decorative feature while coordinating easily with gold-themed Christmas trees, garlands and festive table decorations. A versatile seasonal ornament for hallways, living rooms and Christmas home displays.
LUXURIOUS GOLD FESTIVE ARRANGEMENT: Gold baubles, sparkling decorative leaves, berry sprays and pinecones combine with an oversized bow to create an attractive Christmas wreath that adds warmth and seasonal character to your home.
SOFT WARM WHITE CHRISTMAS LIGHTS: Built-in LEDs provide gentle illumination throughout the decorative arrangement, enhancing the gold accents and foliage while creating an inviting atmosphere during evening celebrations and winter nights.
STEADY OR FLASHING LIGHT EFFECT: Select continuous lighting for a subtle festive glow or switch to flashing mode for a more lively display, providing two convenient options for decorating entrances, hallways and living spaces.
CONVENIENT CABLE-FREE BATTERY POWER: Requires three AA batteries for operation, making the wreath easy to position around suitable indoor display areas without relying on electrical sockets or extension leads. Batteries must be purchased separately.
LARGE 60CM CIRCULAR DESIGN: Approximately 60cm in diameter, providing generous decorative coverage for suitable doors, walls and windows while creating a noticeable Christmas feature that complements other festive home accessories.

Inflatable Santa
This inflatable santa adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. The multicoloured finish and fabric construction give it a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Father Christmas Motif
A Father Christmas motif gives the design a recognisable festive character. It brings a seasonal focal point to the arrangement and can be paired with other Christmas decorations to create a consistent theme across the display.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.
